description: Registry record for one Indian company, LLP or foreign company by identifier: CIN (21 characters, e.g. U72900KA2015PTC080123), LLPIN (e.g. AAB-1234) or FCRN. Returns status, incorporation date, ROC, state, capital, activity and the board (names, DINs, designations). No personal contacts. Cite source_url.
name: lookup_company
title: Look up an Indian company or LLP
